sourceWitness.inventory: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- *.rs *.toml *.lock; unique ordinal path order
sourceWitness.encoding: UTF-8 concatenated relative path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + LF

checks.command: cargo +stable test -p claw-application -p claw-state -p claw-runtime -p claw-channel-sdk -p claw-channels -p gta-claw-daemon --all-targets --locked --quiet
cargo +stable clippy -p claw-application -p claw-state -p claw-runtime -p claw-channel-sdk -p claw-channels -p gta-claw-daemon --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

earlierCheck: root cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked --offline passed after adding PortError::OutcomeUnknown and before the write-fence/channel additions
unverified: physical commit-failure injection or power loss
channel durable inbox/outbox and delivery deduplication
